info.headline: Notify NYC - Planned Natural Gas Work - 10/15 - Surf Avenue (BK)
info.description:
Notification issued 10-14-2026 at 03:00 PM.
National Grid is scheduled to conduct planned natural gas work on 10/15, which may result in an odor of natural gas near Surf Avenue between West 5th Street and Brighton Beach Avenue in Brooklyn. The work is scheduled to take place between 8:00 AM and 8:00 PM. Please report natural gas emergencies to 9-1-1 if they occur.
